# AWS 3-Tier Deployment for AI & Web Infra (with OpenTofu)

> A complete, production-ready infrastructure project and documentation repository for deploying a highly-available, secure, cost-optimized 3-Tier Architecture on AWS in the `ap-southeast-5` (Malaysia) region, fully integrated with AWS WAFv2, OpenTofu, and modern best practices.

This index is curated specifically for AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and automated assistants to easily navigate and ingest the extensive system architecture, costing, disaster recovery, and integration documentation compiled in this repository.

## Project Resources

- [README.md](README.md) : The central portal and entrypoint for developers, showcasing the architecture, repository layout, local execution, and deployment steps.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) : Root gateway file for AI agents (specifically Google Jules & Antigravity), redirecting to the Sovereign Constitution.
- [.agents/AGENTS.md](.agents/AGENTS.md) : Sovereign Constitution & Agent Rulebook detailing Rule 29 and local knowledge-first constraints.
- [.agents/brain/active_context_manifest.md](.agents/brain/active_context_manifest.md) : Persistent spatial memory manifest mapping active conversation threads and checkpoints.
- [HISTORY.md](HISTORY.md) : Detailed background narrative on the project's inception, engineering decisions, and architecture evolution from Day 0.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) : Structured record of all major version milestones, changes, features, and fixes from inception to v1.0.0.

## Core Architectural Documentation

- [AWS Phased Adoption Roadmap](docs/aws-adoption-roadmap.md) : Multi-year week-by-week and month-by-month AWS service growth plan mapped from the project Gantt chart.
- [System Architecture](docs/architecture.md) : Physical VPC layouts, routing tables, and the Multi-AZ subnet topology designed for ap-southeast-5.
- [Developer Design Mapping](docs/developer-design-mapping.md) : Deep technical alignment of legacy single-VM deployment architectures to highly-available AWS-native managed services.
- [Separation of Concerns](docs/asg-separation-of-concern.md) : Guidelines on designing stateless ASGs, managing persistent session/media state, and selecting S3 vs. Amazon EFS.
- [OpenTofu Migration](docs/opentofu-migration.md) : Deep dive comparison, CLI syntax mapping, state-locking configurations, and compatibility guides between Terraform and OpenTofu.
- [AMI Baking and Compliance](docs/ami-design.md) : Custom pre-baked AMI strategy on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS using HashiCorp Packer, Ansible, and the ASIMP security hardening framework.
- [Route 53 & DNS Troubleshooting](docs/route53.md) : Domain mapping, ACM SSL/TLS certificates, and diagnostic guides for private-subnet DNS resolution failures.
- [Secure Jumphost Hardening](docs/jumphost.md) : Operational manual for connecting via SSH Bastion, whitelisting Cyberjaya developer IP subnets, client setups, and key security.
- [Hybrid Cloud Connectivity](docs/hybrid-onprem.md) : Hybrid on-premises networking (VPN, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway) cost comparisons vs. modern cost-optimized API-based and MCP-proxy integration.
- [Disaster Recovery & Sovereignty](docs/dr-options.md) : Multi-AZ high availability strategies, AWS DRS (Strategy E), local compliance reviews under Malaysian PDPA (2010 & 2025 CBPDT Guidelines), and detailed USD/MYR pricing.
- [PostgreSQL Engine Comparison](docs/postgresql-comparison.md) : RDS PostgreSQL 17 Multi-AZ vs. Percona Server on EC2, covering Patroni, PgBouncer, telemetry, extension availability, and total cost of ownership.
- [Redis vs. Valkey Comparison](docs/redis-vs-valkey.md) : Strategic, licensing, and costing comparison (Baseline vs. High-Performance) of Redis OSS vs. Valkey on AWS and on-premises.
- [RAGFlow + Langfuse GPU Guide](docs/ragflow-langfuse.md) : Comprehensive architectural and economic analysis of RAGFlow and Langfuse, including critical GPU workloads, AWS-native vs. On-Premises deployments, and API/MCP hybrid connectivity.
- [Google Antigravity Skills Guide](docs/antigravity-skills.md) : Comprehensive developer guide outlining the Agent Skills ecosystem standard, directory scopes, and how Google Jules shares the jules-knowledge skill with Google Antigravity.
- [SOP: Knowledge-First Discovery](docs/SOP-KNOWLEDGE-FIRST-DISCOVERY.md) : Standard Operating Procedure outlining how AI agents perform local documentation search before probing remote targets.
- [Technology Stack Comparison](docs/tech-stack-comparison.md) : Comprehensive architectural mapping of containerized technologies (Java/Spring, React, Postgres, Valkey) and AWS-native options for third-party platforms (Twilio, Meta, OpenAI).
- [Wazuh Standalone Installation & Costing](docs/wazuh.md) : Comprehensive guide detailing the best and cheapest cloud deployment strategy for standalone Wazuh in the cloud (AWS Marketplace AMI and Graviton Ubuntu modes), with separated USD/MYR costing models for budget isolation.
- [Strategic Comparative Review](docs/aws-vs-self-hosted-review.md) : Comprehensive strategic analysis and financial TCO comparison of an AWS-Native Managed Platform against a Self-Hosted / On-Premises Custom Stack in Malaysia.
- [Load Testing Assumptions & Sizing Guide](docs/load-test-assumptions.md) : Workload definitions, SLA metrics, architectural performance assumptions, and multi-VU sizing models from 100 to 10,000 VUs.
- [Context7 AI Chat Integration Guide](docs/context7.md) : Detailed guide explaining our floating AI chat assistant widget, how to use it, and background info about Context7 and Upstash.
- [Security Posture Assessment (SPA) Checklist](docs/audits/security-posture-assessment.md) : Comprehensive security control audit checklist, fully customized for our Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Valkey, and RAGFlow/Langfuse AI infrastructure.
- [Output of ASIMP](docs/audits/asimp-output.md) : Example execution output, report format, and baseline metrics generated by ASIMP.
- [Output of Lynis](docs/audits/lynis-output.md) : High-fidelity example of the Lynis host auditing utility scanning logs, attributes, and suggestions.
- [Output of OpenSCAP](docs/audits/openscap-output.md) : Detailed example of OpenSCAP CIS Level 2 scan evaluation rules, results, and generated remediations.
- [AWS Services vs. On-Premises Open-Source Stack Comparison](docs/aws-vs-onprem-stack-comparison.md) : Comprehensive 12-layer comparison guide mapping AWS services to self-hosted equivalents.

## Onsite On-Premises Documentation Volume

- [Onsite On-Premises Blueprint Portal](docs/onprem/index.md) : Overview portal and strategic rationale for moving from AWS to rootless, open-source local on-premises deployments.
- [VM & Network Architecture](docs/onprem/architecture.md) : Physical host VM sizing and network configurations, multi-tier VLAN isolation, and stateful routing rulesets.
- [Rootless Podman 5+ & systemd Quadlets](docs/onprem/podman-quadlet.md) : Configuration guidelines for running production containers without administrative root rights using keep-id remapping.
- [On-Premises Infrastructure with Ansible](docs/onprem/ansible-orchestration.md) : Symmetric privilege separation, FQCN-compliant plays, and local CI/CD pipelines integrating Gitea, Semaphore, and ARA.
- [Open-Source Containerized Stack Specifications](docs/onprem/open-source-stack.md) : Standard blueprints replacing core AWS managed components with containerized equivalents (BunkerWeb, Valkey, Postgres 17, Keycloak, Ollama, RAGFlow, and Langfuse).
- [Enterprise Percona Server Setup](docs/onprem/percona-postgresql.md) : Standard blueprints for running production-grade Percona Server for PostgreSQL 17 on-premises using Patroni cluster management, etcd distributed consensus stores, pg_backrest, and HAProxy load balancing.

## Root Infrastructure Configurations

- [Root Configurations Portal](docs/root-files.md) : Detailed summary of root-level files including variables, outputs, and providers.
- [Root main.tf](terraform/main.tf) : Main OpenTofu file calling network, database, compute, cache, security, and WAF submodules.
- [Root variables.tf](terraform/variables.tf) : Centralized parameters declaring regions, CIDR ranges, instance families, and boolean toggles.
- [Root outputs.tf](terraform/outputs.tf) : Infrastructure endpoints, DNS values, subnets, and load balancer targets.
- [Root providers.tf](terraform/providers.tf) : Configures providers like AWS, HashiCorp Random, TLS, and OpenTofu local backend requirements.

## Infrastructure Submodules

- [VPC Module](docs/modules/vpc.md) : Subnetting logic, NAT Gateways, Internet Gateways, and Route Table setups.
- [Security Groups Module](docs/modules/security_groups.md) : Zero-Trust network rulesets establishing secure ingress/egress boundaries.
- [WAF Module](docs/modules/waf.md) : Layer-7 WAFv2 Web ACL configuration including rate limits and OWASP rulesets protecting the ALB.
- [ALB Module](docs/modules/alb.md) : Application Load Balancer target routing, listeners, and health check patterns.
- [ASG Module](docs/modules/asg.md) : Launch templates, dynamic ARM64/x86_64 family detection, and auto-scaling rules.
- [RDS Module](docs/modules/rds.md) : PostgreSQL parameter group tuning, Multi-AZ high availability, and storage configurations.
- [Standalone EC2 Module](docs/modules/standalone_ec2.md) : Standalone staging/development Ubuntu 26.04 LTS servers for pre-baking AMIs.
- [ElastiCache Valkey Module](docs/modules/elasticache.md) : Secure Valkey caching nodes with transit/at-rest encryption.
- [Jumphost Module](docs/modules/jumphost.md) : SSH Bastion deployment whitelisting Cyberjaya CIDRs and injecting downstream compute ingress rules.

## Deployment, Automation, and Costing

- [Costing Guide](docs/costing.md) : Granular USD and MYR billing comparisons for Baseline Cost-Optimized ($426.75 USD) and High-Performance ($1,064.46 USD) setups.
- [Automation Scripts Portal](docs/scripts.md) : Functional descriptions of scripts for deployment, teardown, and initialization.
- [deploy.sh](scripts/deploy.sh) : Shell script coordinating formatting, linting, validation, and planning for OpenTofu deployments.
- [destroy.sh](scripts/destroy.sh) : Safe teardown script for clearing all provisioned resources.
- [user_data.sh](scripts/user_data.sh) : Cloud-init shell bootstrapping for instance initialization.
- [prepare_docs.py](scripts/prepare_docs.py) : Python utility enforcing Jekyll metadata prepending across documentation files.
- [CI/CD Workflow](docs/cicd.md) : Overview of the OIDC-based GitHub Actions workflow.
- [GitLab EFS CI/CD Integration](docs/gitlab-efs-cicd.md) : Advanced pipelines mapping NFS mounts, Nginx custom paths, dynamic storage, and secure scaling.
